definitions.explanation: A person or entity that owns shares in a company. An important term in business and finance.

examples.japanese: {株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい}が{来月|らいげつ}{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: A shareholders' meeting will be held next month.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{株主|かぶぬし}が{経営|けいえい}に{口|くち}を{出|だ}すことがある。
examples.english: Major shareholders sometimes have a say in management.

examples.japanese: {株主|かぶぬし}への{配当金|はいとうきん}を{増|ふ}やすために、{会社|かいしゃ}は{利益|りえき}の{向上|こうじょう}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: The company is focusing on improving profits in order to increase dividends to shareholders.

notes:
USAGE:
{株主|かぶぬし} is a compound of {株|かぶ} (stock, shares) and {主|ぬし} (owner, holder). It is a fundamental business term in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {株主総会|かぶぬしそうかい} (shareholders' meeting, general meeting of shareholders)
- {大株主|おおかぶぬし} (major shareholder)
- {株主|かぶぬし}{優待|ゆうたい} (shareholder benefits/perks)
- {株主|かぶぬし}{配当|はいとう} (shareholder dividend)
- {個人|こじん}{株主|かぶぬし} (individual shareholder)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {株主|かぶぬし}: shareholder (person who owns shares)
- {投資家|とうしか}: investor (broader, any type of investment)
- {出資者|しゅっししゃ}: contributor, financial backer (not limited to stocks)
